FN-FYUHCD5-1
FISCAL NOTE
Senate Bill 165
Committee: Education Policy Sponsor: Senator Rodger Smitherman
Analyst: John Friedenreich Date: 04/15/2024
Senate Bill 165 as introduced would increase the administrative obligations of the State Board
of Education and the local boards of education to adopt policies regarding long-term suspension
or expulsion.
Page 1

FN-FYUHCD5-2
FISCAL NOTE
Senate Bill 165
Committee: Education Policy Sponsor: Senator Rodger Smitherman
Analyst: John Friedenreich Date: 04/17/2024
Senate Bill 165 as reported by the Committee on Education Policy would increase the
administrative obligations of the local boards of education to adopt policies regarding long-term
alternative school placement, suspension or expulsion.
